title: UAAP: Bulldogs outduel Tamaraws to conclude first round as top seed
summary: National University concluded the first round of UAAP Season 89 men's basketball atop the standings after outdueling Far Eastern University, 69-65, on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym in Katipunan.
